listingDetail.lightboxHint: Use the arrow keys or swipe to move between photos and videos. Double-tap or pinch a photo to zoom.
listingDetail.videoUnavailableHint: We couldn't load this video. Check your connection and try again.
listingDetail.expiredBanner: This ad has expired and is no longer available. See similar land below.
listingDetail.unavailableContact: This ad is no longer available, so the seller can't be contacted through it.
listingDetail.safety1: Visit the plot in person, ideally with someone you trust, before agreeing to anything.
listingDetail.safety2: Check the deed (dolil), khatian and mutation (namjari) at the sub-registry and AC (Land) office.
listingDetail.safety3: Never pay advance, booking or "token" money before the papers are verified.
listingDetail.safety4: Pay through a bank rather than in cash, and get a signed receipt.
listingDetail.safety5: Be wary of prices far below the area's market rate or pressure to decide quickly.
